claims.experiment: CH3CN and 13CH3CN velocity fields and PV plots in six sources
claims.result: Velocity gradients in six cores, three with Keplerian-like butterfly PV patterns
claims.finding: Three disc candidates (G29.96, G345.50 M and S), three questionable, one with none

evidence.quote: In six of these a velocity gradient is seen across the core, three of which show evidence of Keplerian-like rotation.

claims.hypothesis: Disc detectability depends on evolutionary stage
claims.experiment: Compare disc status with Lbol/Mgas and distance
claims.result: Best candidates at intermediate Lbol/Mgas; most evolved source has no disc evidence
claims.finding: Too young and too old are unsuited for detecting molecular discs

evidence.loc: 6. Are there discs around O-type stars?
evidence.quote: the detectability of a circumstellar disc around an O-type star appears sensitive to the evolutionary stage of the YSO.

claims.hypothesis: Jets are common in massive YSOs
claims.result: Poorly collimated bipolar outflows in few sources
claims.finding: Collimated jets may be rare or short-lived, or multiplicity affects outflows

evidence.quote: collimated jets might be rare – perhaps short-lived – and the ejection phenomenon could be dominated by wide-angle winds

why_this_method.value: Statistical continuum estimate because line forest prevents identifying line-free channels

evidence.quote: almost all the observed spectra present a “line forest”, which makes the visual identification of a continuum level extremely difficult.

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: CH3CN K=0,1 rejected for kinematics because they overlap

evidence.quote: they heavily overlap each other, which makes them unusable for kinematical studies.

limitations_admitted.value: Low number statistics; no model fits so stellar masses unconstrained

evidence.loc: 6. Are there discs around O-type stars?
evidence.quote: model fits analogous to that of Johnston et al. (2015) will be needed, a goal which is beyond the scope of the present study.

referee_caveats_inferred: Disc identification is qualitative (visual PV butterfly) with no fits or uncertainties
Mass estimates rely on assumed T, kappa; opacity affects G31.41
Evolutionary conclusion rests on six sources with Lbol/Mgas proxy
